SELECT
  p.product_name
FROM contoso_served.dim_product AS p
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s

      s.product_key = p.product_key
      AND s.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND s.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  )
ORDER BY

body.value: The 56 products in Contoso's catalogue that sold nothing at all during calendar year 2024 — one row per product, its name only, alphabetically. A product appears purely because no order placed between 1 January and 31 December 2024 contained it: in any store, through the shops or the web, at any quantity or value. WHAT I DID NOT INCLUDE: no revenue, units or dates, because the question asks which products and not how much; no product that sold even a single unit in 2024, however small; and no claim about WHY each is here — discontinued, not yet launched, or simply unbought is something this bundle cannot distinguish, as the product carries no status or launch date. These are not never-sold products: all 2,517 catalogue products sold at some point in the 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31 extent, so every one of these 56 sold in a year other than 2024.

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    product_key,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS ordered_2024,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN delivery_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND delivery_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS delivered_2024
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  GROUP BY
    product_key
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS products_ever_sold,
  SUM(ordered_2024) AS products_ordered_in_2024,
  SUM(delivered_2024) AS products_delivered_in_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_2024 = 1 AND delivered_2024 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_not_delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_2024 = 0 AND delivered_2024 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_not_ordered,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
    WHERE
      order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)

FROM p

All 2,461 keys resolve to catalogue rows, so the set is a strict subset of step 1's 2,517.

readings.took: sold at least once — any number of lines, any quantity, any channel, any store, any customer, any currency
readings.could_also_mean: sold above some threshold of units or revenue, which would move products with only token 2024 sales onto the unsold list
readings.declaration: The question sets no threshold and 'NOT sold' is a plain absence, so no threshold is imposed. Disclosed because it is the boundary that defines the answer: a product with a single unit sold in 2024 counts as sold and is excluded from the final list.

readings.took: the declared product_key edge, v_contoso5_sales_line.product_key = dim_product.product_key
readings.declaration: order__of__product and net_revenue__by__product both declare this join_rule, the latter as (1..N) -> (1) and verified in evidence/edge_measurements.json. Measured here: 0 orphan keys, so the hop loses no sale and invents no product.

turns.why: Verify the pivot joins cleanly — that every product key on a 2024 sales line resolves to a catalogue row — since an orphan key would break the 2,517 minus 2,461 subtraction in step 5.
turns.did:
WITH sold_2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.product_key
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  WHERE
    s.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND s.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS distinct_products_on_2024_lines,
  COUNT(p.product_key) AS matched_to_catalogue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_keys,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_product
  ) - COUNT(p.product_key) AS catalogue_remainder
FROM sold_2024 AS s
LEFT JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key

value.means: The 56 products in Contoso's catalogue that sold nothing at all during calendar year 2024 — one row per product, its name only, alphabetically. A product appears purely because no order placed between 1 January and 31 December 2024 contained it: in any store, through the shops or the web, at any quantity or value. WHAT I DID NOT INCLUDE: no revenue, units or dates, because the question asks which products and not how much; no product that sold even a single unit in 2024, however small; and no claim about WHY each is here — discontinued, not yet launched, or simply unbought is something this bundle cannot distinguish, as the product carries no status or launch date. These are not never-sold products: all 2,517 catalogue products sold at some point in the 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31 extent, so every one of these 56 sold in a year other than 2024.

readings.declaration: order.default.period_is_order_date declares `default: ordered`, so the default settles it and I did not ask. Measured cost of the alternative: it moves exactly ONE row. `Litware Refrigerator 9.7CuFt M560 White` had no 2024 order but a delivery landing in 2024, so the delivery reading drops it; the other 55 names are identical under both readings.
